name: app.R
content:
# =============================================================================
# Ghana Fiscal Explorer
#
# Central government revenue, spending, deficits and financing from the
# Ministry of Finance Fiscal Data workbooks, 2008 to date. Every chart is a
# ggplot in theme_alfred, made interactive with ggiraph. The page shell is
# bslib, the same layout as the Ghana GDP Explorer.
#
#   app.R              wiring only
#   R/00_setup.R       theme, palette, chart builders, sparklines and icons
#   R/01_data.R        data access: any series, measure and frequency
#   R/mod_*.R          one Shiny module per view
#   data/fiscal.rds    built by build_data.R from the database tables
#
# Requires: shiny, bslib (>= 0.6), dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2, ggiraph, forcats, scales, readr
# =============================================================================

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

if (dir.exists("R")) for (f in list.files("R", pattern = "[.][Rr]$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)

app_theme <- bs_theme(
  version = 5,
  bg = "floralwhite", fg = "#4A4A4A",
  primary = RUST, secondary = "#5F7A8A", success = GREEN, danger = "#7A3B2E",
  "navbar-bg" = TILE[["navy"]],
  "card-border-color" = "#E7DECB",
  "card-cap-bg" = "#F6EFE2",
  "border-radius" = "0.25rem"
)

app_css <- HTML("
  .note { color:#8C8C8C; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; }
  .story { font-size:15px; line-height:1.65; color:#4A4A4A; }
  .card-header { font-weight:700; color:#4D4D4D; font-size:13px;
                 text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; }
  .bslib-value-box .value-box-title { font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700;
                 text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; opacity:0.92; }
  .bslib-value-box .value-box-value { font-size:26px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.15; }
  .bslib-value-box p { margin-bottom:0.15rem; }
  .vb-context { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; opacity:0.9; line-height:1.35; }
  .vb-link a, .vb-link a:hover, .vb-link a:focus {
                 color:#FFFFFF; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700;
                 text-decoration:underline; opacity:0.9; }
  .vb-spark { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:34px;
              opacity:0.45; pointer-events:none; }
  .bslib-value-box .value-box-area { position:relative; }
")

ui <- page_navbar(
  id = "tab",
  title = "Ghana Fiscal Explorer",
  theme = app_theme,
  fillable = FALSE,
  header = tagList(tags$head(tags$style(app_css))),

  nav_panel("Overview",         mod_overview_ui("overview")),
  nav_panel("Explorer",         mod_explorer_ui("explorer")),
  nav_panel("Pressures",        mod_pressures_ui("pressures")),
  nav_panel("Budget vs actual", mod_budget_ui("budget")),
  nav_panel("Revenue mix",      mod_revenue_ui("revenue")),
  nav_panel("Monthly",          mod_monthly_ui("monthly")),
  nav_panel("Year to date",     mod_ytd_ui("ytd")),
  nav_panel("Data",             mod_data_ui("data")),
  nav_panel(
    "Notes",
    card(
      card_header("How to read this"),
      card_body(
        div(
          style = "max-width:820px;",
          p(strong("Outturns are provisional."), " Each year's figures are the full-year provisional
            outturn from that year's Fiscal Data workbook. MoF revises them later, so they will not
            always match the next year's budget statement."),
          p(strong("Ratios to GDP use one consistent GDP series."), " The workbooks carry GDP on three
            different base years, which makes their own ratios jump at each rebasing. This app uses
            World Bank nominal GDP (2013 base from 2013) and splices 2008-2012 onto the 2013 base.
            The latest year uses the MoF projection until World Bank publishes it."),
          p(strong("The deficit is the cash balance including divestiture and discrepancy."), " It is
            MoF's headline deficit and runs continuously from 2011."),
          p(strong("2013 is a break."), " Before 2013 MoF used an older classification: personal
            emoluments rather than compensation of employees, direct and indirect taxes rather than
            GFS tax groups. Those years are mapped to the nearest current line but are not strictly
            comparable. Subsidies, social benefits and statutory transfers start in 2013."),
          p(strong("Budget against actual."), " Outturns are compared with the revised (mid-year)
            budget where there is one, otherwise the original budget. Monthly targets are MoF's
            programme figures."),
          p(strong("Partial years."), " The latest year has months only. Use the Year to date tab to
            compare it with the same months of earlier years."),
          p(strong("Source."), " Ministry of Finance, Fiscal Data (mofep.gov.gh/fiscal-data), Summary of
            Central Government Operations, 2008 to date. The full database, with every line of every
            table, is at github.com/aappiah17.")
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  nav_spacer(),
  nav_item(uiOutput("headline", inline = TRUE))
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  dat <- reactive({
    validate(need(file.exists("data/fiscal.rds"), "data/fiscal.rds not found. Run build_data.R first."))
    load_fiscal("data/fiscal.rds")
  })

  output$headline <- renderUI({
    d <- dat()
    m <- as.integer(format(d$latest_date, "%m")); y <- as.integer(format(d$latest_date, "%Y"))
    t <- ytd_totals(d, c("tax_revenue", "interest"), m, c(y - 1, y))
    g <- function(id) {
      v <- t$value[t$series_id == id]; yy <- t$year[t$series_id == id]
      if (length(v) == 2) 100 * (v[yy == y] / v[yy == y - 1] - 1) else NA_real_
    }
    span(
      style = "color:rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-weight:600; font-size:13px;",
      sprintf("Jan-%s %d  |  tax revenue %+.0f%%  |  interest %+.0f%%",
              month.abb[m], y, g("tax_revenue"), g("interest"))
    )
  })

  mod_overview_server("overview", dat, parent = session)
  mod_explorer_server("explorer", dat)
  mod_pressures_server("pressures", dat)
  mod_budget_server("budget", dat)
  mod_revenue_server("revenue", dat)
  mod_monthly_server("monthly", dat)
  mod_ytd_server("ytd", dat)
  mod_data_server("data", dat)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

name: R/00_setup.R
content:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared look and feel, plus the chart builders every module uses.
# Same palette and theme as the Ghana GDP Explorer, so the dashboards match.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

RUST <- "#A9432C"; GREY <- "#8C8C8C"; DARK <- "#4F4F4F"; BG <- "floralwhite"
GREEN <- "#2F6B4F"; LIGHT <- "#C9C2B6"
CAP <- "Data: Ministry of Finance, Fiscal Data | Chart: alfredappiah.com"
ELECTION_YEARS <- c(2008, 2012, 2016, 2020, 2024)

theme_alfred <- function(base_size = 12) {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.background   = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = BG, colour = NA),
      panel.background  = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = BG, colour = NA),
      panel.grid        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position   = "none",
      strip.text        = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.title          = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30", size = 16,
                                                  face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)),
      plot.subtitle       = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey55", size = 11,
                                                  face = "bold", lineheight = 1.3,
                                                  margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 14)),
      plot.caption        = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 1, colour = "grey55", size = 10,
                                                  face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
      axis.text           = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title          = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x        = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y        = ggplot2::element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 10)),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.margin         = ggplot2::margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
    )
}

# girafe wrapper: keeps the ggplot rendering, adds hover, tooltip and PNG export
gf <- function(p, height = 6.2) {
  girafe(
    ggobj = p, width_svg = 9.6, height_svg = height,
    options = list(
      opts_hover(css = "stroke-width:3;opacity:1;"),
      opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.25;"),
      opts_tooltip(css = paste0("background:", BG, ";border:1px solid ", RUST, ";",
                                "padding:6px 9px;font-family:sans-serif;font-weight:bold;",
                                "font-size:12px;color:", DARK, ";border-radius:3px;")),
      opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
      opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
note <- function(...) div(class = "note", ...)

fmt_val <- function(x, unit, digits = 1) {
  if (unit == "bn") sprintf(paste0("GH¢%.", digits, "f bn"), x)
  else sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), x)
}
axis_lab <- function(unit) {
  if (unit == "bn") function(x) paste0("GH¢", format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), "bn")
  else function(x) paste0(x, "%")
}

# whole-year axis breaks that stay inside the data, whatever the label padding
data_breaks <- function(t, n = 8) {
  r <- range(t, na.rm = TRUE)
  b <- unique(floor(pretty(r, n = n)))
  b[b >= floor(r[1]) & b <= ceiling(r[2])]
}

year_slider <- function(id, years, value = NULL, label = "Years") {
  rng <- range(years, na.rm = TRUE)
  sliderInput(id, label, min = rng[1], max = rng[2],
              value = value %||% rng, step = 1, sep = "")
}

# --- line chart -------------------------------------------------------------
# df needs: t (numeric, years or fractional years), period, item, value.
line_chart <- function(df, highlight = NULL, title = "", subtitle = "", unit = "%",
                       zero_line = FALSE, facet = FALSE, label_ends = TRUE, digits = 1,
                       ref = NULL, ref_label = NULL, target = NULL) {
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(hl = .data$item %in% highlight,
                  tip = paste0(.data$item, "\n", .data$period, ": ", fmt_val(.data$value, unit, digits)))
  ends <- df |> dplyr::group_by(.data$item) |> dplyr::slice_max(.data$t, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$t, .data$value, group = .data$item))
  if (zero_line) p <- p + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linetype = "dashed")
  if (!is.null(ref)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = ref, colour = "grey35", linetype = "dashed")
    if (!is.null(ref_label)) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::annotate("text", x = min(df$t), y = ref, label = ref_label, vjust = -0.6,
                                 hjust = 0, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey35")
    }
  }
  if (!is.null(target) && nrow(target) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_line(data = target, ggplot2::aes(.data$t, .data$value, group = .data$item),
                                colour = RUST, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7,
                                inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }

  if (facet) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$item, data_id = .data$item),
                            colour = RUST, linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$item),
                             colour = RUST, size = 1.6) +
      ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ item, scales = "free_y")
  } else {
    p <- p +
      geom_line_interactive(ggplot2::aes(colour = .data$hl, tooltip = .data$item, data_id = .data$item),
                            linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point_interactive(ggplot2::aes(colour = .data$hl, tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$item),
                             size = 1.8) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RUST, `FALSE` = DARK))
    if (label_ends) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = ends,
        ggplot2::aes(label = paste0(.data$item, "  ", fmt_val(.data$value, unit, digits)),
                     colour = .data$hl),
        hjust = -0.06, size = 3.6, fontface = "bold")
    }
  }
  p +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = data_breaks(df$t, if (facet) 4 else 8),
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, if (facet || !label_ends) 0.04 else 0.36))) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = axis_lab(unit)) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred()
}

# --- vertical bars over years ----------------------------------------------
# df needs: t, period, value, hl (logical). Labels every bar.
col_chart <- function(df, title = "", subtitle = "", unit = "%", digits = 0,
                      ref = NULL, ref_label = NULL, hl_label = NULL, other_label = NULL) {
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(tip = paste0(.data$period, ": ", fmt_val(.data$value, unit, 1)),
                  lab = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), .data$value))
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$t, .data$value, fill = .data$hl)) +
    geom_col_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$period), width = 0.72) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = .data$lab, colour = .data$hl,
                                    vjust = ifelse(.data$value >= 0, -0.45, 1.3)),
                       size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RUST, `FALSE` = GREY)) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RUST, `FALSE` = "grey35"))
  if (!is.null(ref)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = ref, colour = "grey35", linetype = "dashed")
    # bars sit under any in-plot label, so the reference line is explained in the subtitle
    if (!is.null(ref_label)) subtitle <- paste0(subtitle, "\nDashed line: ", ref_label)
  }
  if (!is.null(hl_label)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::annotate("text", x = min(df$t) - 0.4, y = max(df$value, 0) * c(1.12, 1.03),
                               hjust = 0, size = 3.8, fontface = "bold",
                               label = c(hl_label, other_label), colour = c(RUST, GREY))
  }
  p +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = data_breaks(df$t, 9), expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.5)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = axis_lab(unit), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.16))) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred()
}

# --- horizontal bars ---------------------------------------------------------
# df needs: item, value. Bars above `ref` in rust, below in grey.
hbar_chart <- function(df, title = "", subtitle = "", unit = "%", digits = 0, ref = NULL) {
  base <- ref %||% 0
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(item = forcats::fct_reorder(.data$item, .data$value),
                  hl = .data$value >= base,
                  tip = paste0(.data$item, "\n", fmt_val(.data$value, unit, 1)))
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$value, .data$item, fill = .data$hl)) +
    geom_col_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$item), width = 0.72) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), .data$value)),
                       hjust = -0.15, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = RUST, `FALSE` = GREY)) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12)))
  if (!is.null(ref)) p <- p + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = ref, colour = "grey20", linetype = "dashed")
  p +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred() + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())
}

# --- stacked bars over years -----------------------------------------------
stack_chart <- function(df, title = "", subtitle = "", unit = "%", ref = NULL, ref_label = NULL,
                        totals = FALSE, pal = NULL) {
  lv <- levels(factor(df$item))
  if (is.null(pal)) {
    pal <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(RUST, "#C98A6B", LIGHT, GREY, DARK))(length(lv))
    names(pal) <- lv
  }
  df <- df |>
    dplyr::mutate(tip = paste0(.data$item, "\n", .data$period, ": ", fmt_val(.data$value, unit, 1)))
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$t, .data$value, fill = .data$item)) +
    geom_col_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = .data$item), width = 0.75,
                         position = "stack")
  if (totals) {
    tot <- df |> dplyr::group_by(.data$t) |> dplyr::summarise(total = sum(.data$value), .groups = "drop")
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_text(data = tot, ggplot2::aes(.data$t, .data$total, label = round(.data$total)),
                                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.45, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold",
                                colour = "grey35")
  }
  if (!is.null(ref)) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = ref, colour = "grey20", linetype = "dashed")
    if (!is.null(ref_label)) {
      p <- p + ggplot2::annotate("text", x = min(df$t) - 0.4, y = ref, label = ref_label, vjust = -0.6,
                                 hjust = 0, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey20")
    }
  }
  p +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = data_breaks(df$t, 9), expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.5)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = axis_lab(unit), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

# --- grouped bars by item ----------------------------------------------------
# df needs: item, grp (factor), value; the last level of grp is highlighted.
group_chart <- function(df, title = "", subtitle = "", unit = "bn", chg = NULL) {
  lv <- levels(df$grp)
  pal <- stats::setNames(c(grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#DDD6CA", GREY))(length(lv) - 1), RUST), lv)
  df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(tip = paste0(.data$item, ", ", .data$grp, "\n", fmt_val(.data$value, unit, 1)))
  pd <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.82)
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(.data$item, .data$value, fill = .data$grp)) +
    geom_col_interactive(ggplot2::aes(tooltip = .data$tip, data_id = paste(.data$item, .data$grp)),
                         position = pd, width = 0.76) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(.data$value), group = .data$grp), position = pd,
                       vjust = -0.45, size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = pal)
  if (!is.null(chg)) {
    lift <- 0.11 * max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE)   # clear of the tallest bar's value label
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_text(data = chg, ggplot2::aes(.data$item, .data$top + lift, label = .data$lab),
                                inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.7, fontface = "bold", colour = RUST)
  }
  p +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, 16)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = axis_lab(unit), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = CAP) +
    theme_alfred() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "grey35", size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

# --- summary page pieces (same as the GDP explorer) --------------------------
TILE <- c(navy = "#1F3A5F", slate = "#3E5C76", steel = "#5F7A8A", rust = "#A9432C",
          bronze = "#8A6A3B", brick = "#7A3B2E", green = "#2F6B4F", charcoal = "#4A4A4A")

tile_icon <- function(name, size = 26) {
  body <- switch(
    name,
    "trend-up"   = '<polyline points="2,18 8,11 12,14 22,4"/><polyline points="16,4 22,4 22,10"/>',
    "trend-down" = '<polyline points="2,6 8,13 12,10 22,20"/><polyline points="16,20 22,20 22,14"/>',
    "bars"       = '<rect x="3" y="13" width="4" height="9"/><rect x="10" y="7" width="4" height="15"/><rect x="17" y="10" width="4" height="12"/>',
    "clock"      = '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><polyline points="12,6 12,12 17,14"/>',
    "bolt"       = '<polygon points="13,2 4,14 11,14 10,22 20,9 13,9"/>',
    "coins"      = '<ellipse cx="12" cy="6" rx="8" ry="3.2"/><path d="M4 6 v6 c0 1.8 3.6 3.2 8 3.2 s8 -1.4 8 -3.2 V6"/><path d="M4 12 v5 c0 1.8 3.6 3.2 8 3.2 s8 -1.4 8 -3.2 v-5"/>',
    "people"     = '<circle cx="8" cy="8" r="3.2"/><circle cx="16.5" cy="9" r="2.6"/><path d="M2.5 20 c0.6 -4 3 -6 5.5 -6 s4.9 2 5.5 6"/><path d="M13.5 19 c0.4 -3 2 -4.6 3.6 -4.6 s3.4 1.6 4 4.6"/>',
    "build"      = '<path d="M3 21 h18"/><rect x="5" y="10" width="5" height="11"/><rect x="14" y="6" width="5" height="15"/><path d="M5 10 l2.5 -4 l2.5 4"/>',
    "scale"      = '<path d="M12 3 v18"/><path d="M5 7 h14"/><path d="M5 7 l-3 7 h6 z"/><path d="M19 7 l-3 7 h6 z"/><path d="M8 21 h8"/>',
    "target"     = '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.4"/>',
    '<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/>')

                      'stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" ',
                      'stroke-linejoin="round">%s</svg>'), size, size, body))
}

sparkline_svg <- function(v, colour = RUST, w = 150, h = 34, full = FALSE) {
  v <- v[!is.na(v)]
  if (length(v) < 3) return(NULL)
  rng <- range(v); span <- diff(rng)
  x <- seq(0, w, length.out = length(v))
  y <- if (span == 0) rep(h / 2, length(v)) else h - 3 - (v - rng[1]) / span * (h - 6)
  pts <- paste(sprintf("%.1f,%.1f", x, y), collapse = " ")
  fill_pts <- paste0(pts, sprintf(" %.1f,%d 0,%d", w, h, h))
  HTML(sprintf(paste0('<svg width="%s" height="%d" viewBox="0 0 %d %d" ',
                      'preserveAspectRatio="none" role="img">',
                      '<polygon points="%s" fill="%s" opacity="0.22"/>',
                      '<polyline points="%s" fill="none" stroke="%s" stroke-width="2" ',
                      'stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>'),
               if (full) "100%" else as.character(w), h, w, h, fill_pts, colour, pts, colour))
}

delta_chip <- function(now, then, unit = " pp", what = "on the year before") {
  if (length(now) != 1 || length(then) != 1 || is.na(now) || is.na(then)) return(NULL)
  d <- now - then
  arrow <- if (d > 0.05) "▲" else if (d < -0.05) "▼" else "▬"
  sprintf("%s %+.1f%s %s", arrow, d, unit, what)
}

name: R/01_data.R
content:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data access. fiscal.rds is built by build_data.R from the database tables.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MEASURES <- c("GH¢ billion" = "bn", "% of GDP" = "gdp", "% of total revenue" = "rev",
              "% of total spending" = "exp", "Growth on a year earlier" = "growth")
MEASURE_UNIT <- c(bn = "bn", gdp = "%", rev = "%", exp = "%", growth = "%")
MEASURE_LAB <- c(bn = "GH¢ billion", gdp = "share of GDP", rev = "share of total revenue and grants",
                 exp = "share of total spending", growth = "growth on a year earlier")

load_fiscal <- function(path = "data/fiscal.rds") readRDS(path)

series_name <- function(d, ids) d$catalogue$series_name[match(ids, d$catalogue$series_id)]

# grouped choices for selectInput: list(Revenue = c(label = id, ...), ...)
series_choices <- function(d, groups = unique(d$catalogue$group)) {
  cat <- d$catalogue |> dplyr::filter(.data$group %in% groups)
  split(stats::setNames(cat$series_id, cat$series_name), cat$group)[groups]
}

# annual outturns (or budgets) as a wide table, one row per year, with GDP
annual_wide <- function(d, figure = "provisional") {
  d$annual |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$figure_type == figure) |>
    dplyr::select("year", "series_id", "value") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "series_id", values_from = "value") |>
    dplyr::left_join(d$gdp |> dplyr::select("year", "gdp"), by = "year") |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$year)
}

# one tidy table for any set of series, any measure, any frequency
# returns: year, t, period, item, series_id, value
get_series <- function(d, ids, measure = "bn", freq = "annual", figure = "provisional") {
  if (freq == "annual") {
    base <- d$annual |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$figure_type == figure) |>
      dplyr::mutate(t = .data$year, period = as.character(.data$year), key = .data$year)
  } else {
    pt <- if (freq == "monthly") "monthly" else "quarterly"
    base <- d$periodic |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$period_type == pt, .data$figure_type == figure) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        sub = as.integer(sub("^[MQ]", "", .data$period)),
        t = .data$year + (.data$sub - 0.5) / ifelse(pt == "monthly", 12, 4),
        period = if (pt == "monthly") paste(month.abb[.data$sub], .data$year)
                 else paste0(.data$year, " Q", .data$sub),
        key = .data$t)
  }
  out <- base |> dplyr::filter(.data$series_id %in% ids)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(out)

  if (measure %in% c("rev", "exp")) {
    den_id <- if (measure == "rev") "total_revenue_grants" else "total_expenditure"
    den <- base |> dplyr::filter(.data$series_id == den_id) |> dplyr::select("key", den = "value")
    out <- out |> dplyr::inner_join(den, by = "key") |> dplyr::mutate(value = 100 * .data$value / .data$den)
  } else if (measure == "gdp") {
    if (freq != "annual") return(out[0, ])
    out <- out |> dplyr::inner_join(d$gdp, by = "year") |> dplyr::mutate(value = 100 * .data$value / .data$gdp)
  } else if (measure == "growth") {
    prev <- out |> dplyr::transmute(.data$series_id, key = .data$key + 1, prev = .data$value)
    out <- out |> dplyr::inner_join(prev, by = c("series_id", "key")) |>
      dplyr::mutate(value = ifelse(abs(.data$prev) > 0, 100 * (.data$value / abs(.data$prev) - sign(.data$prev)), NA_real_)) |>
      dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$value))
  } else {
    out <- out |> dplyr::mutate(value = .data$value / 1e9)
  }
  out |>
    dplyr::mutate(item = series_name(d, .data$series_id)) |>
    dplyr::select("year", "t", "period", "item", "series_id", "value") |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$item, .data$t)
}

# outturn as % of the revised budget (or the original budget where there is no revision)
execution <- function(d, ids = NULL) {
  tgt <- d$annual |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$figure_type %in% c("budget", "revised_budget")) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$year, .data$series_id) |>
    dplyr::summarise(target = if (any(.data$figure_type == "revised_budget"))
                       .data$value[.data$figure_type == "revised_budget"][1]
                     else .data$value[.data$figure_type == "budget"][1],
                     basis = if (any(.data$figure_type == "revised_budget")) "revised budget" else "budget",
                     .groups = "drop")
  out <- d$annual |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$figure_type == "provisional") |>
    dplyr::select("year", "series_id", actual = "value") |>
    dplyr::inner_join(tgt, by = c("year", "series_id")) |>
    dplyr::filter(abs(.data$target) > 0) |>
    dplyr::mutate(value = 100 * .data$actual / .data$target, item = series_name(d, .data$series_id))
  if (!is.null(ids)) out <- out |> dplyr::filter(.data$series_id %in% ids)
  out
}

# year-to-date totals: January to month m, for each year
ytd_totals <- function(d, ids, m, years) {
  d$periodic |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$period_type == "monthly", .data$figure_type == "provisional",
                  .data$series_id %in% ids, .data$year %in% years,
                  .data$period %in% sprintf("M%02d", seq_len(m))) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$series_id, .data$year) |>
    dplyr::summarise(value = sum(.data$value) / 1e9, n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$n == m) |>
    dplyr::mutate(item = series_name(d, .data$series_id))
}

full_years <- function(d) sort(unique(d$annual$year[d$annual$figure_type == "provisional"]))

# --- Budget vs actual: how much of each budget line was delivered ------------

BUDGET_DEFAULT <- c("domestic_revenue", "tax_revenue", "non_tax_revenue", "grants", "total_expenditure",
                    "compensation", "goods_services", "interest", "capex", "capex_domestic", "capex_foreign")

mod_budget_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = sidebar(
      width = 330, open = "open",
      uiOutput(ns("year_ui")),
      uiOutput(ns("lines_ui")),
      tags$hr(),
      uiOutput(ns("trend_ui")),
      note("Outturn as a share of the revised (mid-year) budget where there is one, otherwise ",
           "the original budget. Above 100% means more was collected or spent than planned.")
    ),
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("One year, line by line"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_year"), height = "560px"))),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("One line, year by year"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_trend"), height = "560px")),
           card_footer(downloadButton(ns("dl"), "Download execution rates (CSV)")))
    )
  )
}

mod_budget_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns
    ex <- reactive(execution(dat()))

    output$year_ui <- renderUI({
      yrs <- sort(unique(ex()$year))
      selectInput(ns("year"), "Year", choices = rev(yrs), selected = max(yrs))
    })
    output$lines_ui <- renderUI({
      selectInput(ns("lines"), "Budget lines", multiple = TRUE,
                  choices = series_choices(dat(), c("Revenue", "Spending")),
                  selected = BUDGET_DEFAULT)
    })
    output$trend_ui <- renderUI({
      selectInput(ns("trend"), "Line to follow over time",
                  choices = series_choices(dat(), c("Revenue", "Spending")), selected = "capex")
    })

    output$p_year <- renderGirafe({
      req(input$year, input$lines)
      df <- ex() |> dplyr::filter(.data$year == as.integer(input$year), .data$series_id %in% input$lines)
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No budget figures for that selection."))
      gf(hbar_chart(df |> dplyr::select("item", "value"),
                    title = paste0("Budget Delivery in ", input$year),
                    subtitle = paste0("Outturn as % of the ", df$basis[1], "; dashed line = 100%"),
                    ref = 100),
         height = 6)
    })

    output$p_trend <- renderGirafe({
      req(input$trend)
      df <- ex() |> dplyr::filter(.data$series_id == input$trend)
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No budget figures for that line."))
      df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(t = .data$year, period = as.character(.data$year),
                                hl = .data$value >= 100)
      gf(col_chart(df, title = paste0(df$item[1], ": Outturn Against Budget"),
                   subtitle = "Outturn as % of the revised budget (or budget); rust = met or beat it",
                   unit = "%", digits = 0, ref = 100, ref_label = "100% of budget"),
         height = 6)
    })

    output$dl <- downloadHandler(
      filename = \() paste0("ghana_budget_execution_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
      content = \(f) readr::write_csv(ex() |> dplyr::select("year", "item", "series_id", "actual",
                                                             "target", "basis", execution_pct = "value"), f)
    )
  })
}

# --- Data browser: any slice of the database, wide, with a download ---------

mod_data_ui <- function(id) {

      note("Budgets exist for annual figures only; programmes for months and quarters. ",
           "The download gives the full series, not just the periods on screen.")
    ),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Processed data"),
      card_body(div(style = "overflow-x:auto;", tableOutput(ns("tbl")))),
      card_footer(downloadButton(ns("dl"), "Download this table (CSV)"))
    )
  )

mod_data_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {

    wide <- reactive({
      req(input$freq, input$figure, input$measure, input$group)
      ids <- dat()$catalogue$series_id[dat()$catalogue$group == input$group]
      long <- get_series(dat(), ids, input$measure, input$freq, figure = input$figure)
      validate(need(nrow(long) > 0, paste("Nothing for that combination. Budgets are annual,",
                                          "programmes are monthly or quarterly, and % of GDP is annual only.")))
      long |>
        dplyr::select("t", "period", "item", "value") |>
        tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "item", values_from = "value") |>
        dplyr::arrange(.data$t) |>
        dplyr::select(-"t")
    })

    output$tbl <- renderTable({
      utils::tail(wide(), input$rows) |>
        dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2)))
    }, striped = TRUE, spacing = "xs", digits = 2, na = "")

    output$dl <- downloadHandler(
      filename = \() paste0("ghana_fiscal_", input$group, "_", input$freq, "_", input$measure, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
      content = \(f) readr::write_csv(wide(), f)
    )
  })
}

# --- Monthly pattern: how a year's money arrives and leaves -----------------

mod_monthly_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  layout_sidebar(
    sidebar = sidebar(
      width = 330, open = "open",
      uiOutput(ns("item_ui")),
      uiOutput(ns("years_ui")),
      radioButtons(ns("view"), "Show",
                   c("Running total through the year" = "cum", "Each month" = "month"), inline = FALSE),
      checkboxInput(ns("prog"), "Add the programme for the latest year", TRUE),
      note("The running total shows how fast a year's money is collected or spent. ",
           "A line that bends sharply up at the end means a December rush.")
    ),
    card(
      full_screen = TRUE,
      card_header("Month by month"),
      card_body(girafeOutput(ns("plot"), height = "620px")),
      card_footer(downloadButton(ns("dl"), "Download this selection (CSV)"))
    )
  )
}

mod_monthly_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns
    output$item_ui <- renderUI({
      selectInput(ns("item"), "Series", choices = series_choices(dat(), c("Revenue", "Spending")),
                  selected = "capex")
    })
    output$years_ui <- renderUI({
      yrs <- sort(unique(dat()$periodic$year))
      selectInput(ns("years"), "Years to compare", choices = rev(yrs), multiple = TRUE,
                  selected = utils::tail(yrs, 3))
    })

    month_data <- reactive({
      req(input$item, input$years)
      dat()$periodic |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$series_id == input$item, .data$period_type == "monthly",
                      .data$year %in% as.integer(input$years)) |>
        dplyr::mutate(m = as.integer(sub("M", "", .data$period))) |>
        dplyr::arrange(.data$figure_type, .data$year, .data$m) |>
        dplyr::group_by(.data$figure_type, .data$year) |>
        dplyr::mutate(cum = cumsum(.data$value) / 1e9) |>
        dplyr::ungroup() |>
        dplyr::mutate(value = .data$value / 1e9)
    })

    output$plot <- renderGirafe({
      df <- month_data()
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No monthly data for that selection."))
      latest <- max(df$year)
      act <- df |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$figure_type == "provisional") |>
        dplyr::transmute(t = .data$m, period = paste(month.abb[.data$m], .data$year),
                         item = as.character(.data$year),
                         value = if (input$view == "cum") .data$cum else .data$value)
      tg <- NULL
      if (isTRUE(input$prog)) {
        tg <- df |>
          dplyr::filter(.data$figure_type == "programme", .data$year == latest) |>
          dplyr::transmute(t = .data$m, item = paste(latest, "programme"),
                           value = if (input$view == "cum") .data$cum else .data$value)
      }
      nm <- series_name(dat(), input$item)
      p <- line_chart(act, highlight = as.character(latest),
                      title = paste0(nm, ", Month by Month"),
                      subtitle = paste0(if (input$view == "cum") "Running total from January" else "Each month",
                                        ", GH¢ billion", if (!is.null(tg) && nrow(tg) > 0)
                                          paste0("; dashed = ", latest, " programme") else ""),
                      unit = "bn", target = tg) +
        ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb,
                                    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.3)))
      gf(p, height = 6.2)
    })

    output$dl <- downloadHandler(
      filename = \() paste0("ghana_monthly_", input$item, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
      content = \(f) readr::write_csv(month_data() |>
                                        dplyr::select("year", "period", "figure_type",
                                                      month_bn = "value", running_total_bn = "cum"), f)
    )
  })
}

# --- Pressures: where the money goes before anything is built ---------------

mod_pressures_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  tagList(
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(4, 8),
      card(
        card_header("Period"),
        card_body(uiOutput(ns("years_ui")),
                  note("Statutory transfers are grants to other government units: the District ",
                       "Assemblies Common Fund, GETFund, NHIF and others. They are shown from 2013."))
      ),
      card(card_header("What this tab shows"),
           card_body(div(class = "story",
             "Three bills come before any new road, school or clinic: wages, interest on the debt, ",
             "and the transfers the law sends to statutory funds. When they rise, capital spending ",
             "is what gives way.")))
    ),
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("Three bills against all revenue"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_fixed"), height = "460px"))),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("Interest against capital spending"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_intcap"), height = "460px")))
    ),
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("Interest as a share of revenue"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_int"), height = "460px"))),
      card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header("The December rush in capital spending"),
           card_body(girafeOutput(ns("p_dec"), height = "460px")))
    )
  )
}

mod_pressures_server <- function(id, dat) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    ns <- session$ns
    output$years_ui <- renderUI(year_slider(ns("years"), full_years(dat())))

    w <- reactive({
      req(input$years)
      annual_wide(dat()) |> dplyr::filter(.data$year >= input$years[1], .data$year <= input$years[2])
    })

    output$p_fixed <- renderGirafe({
      df <- w() |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$grants_other_gov)) |>
        dplyr::transmute(t = .data$year, period = as.character(.data$year),
                         `1 Compensation of employees` = 100 * .data$compensation / .data$total_revenue_grants,
                         `2 Interest` = 100 * .data$interest / .data$total_revenue_grants,
                         `3 Statutory transfers` = 100 * .data$grants_other_gov / .data$total_revenue_grants) |>
        tidyr::pivot_longer(-c("t", "period"), names_to = "item", values_to = "value") |>
        dplyr::mutate(item = sub("^[0-9] ", "", .data$item),
                      item = factor(.data$item, levels = c("Statutory transfers", "Interest",
                                                           "Compensation of employees")))
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "Statutory transfers are shown from 2013. Widen the period."))
      gf(stack_chart(df, title = "Before a Single Road Is Built",
                     subtitle = "Wages, interest and statutory transfers, % of total revenue and grants",
                     ref = 100, ref_label = "100% of revenue", totals = TRUE,
                     pal = c(`Compensation of employees` = GREY, Interest = RUST,
                             `Statutory transfers` = LIGHT)),
         height = 5)
    })

    output$p_intcap <- renderGirafe({
      df <- w() |>
        dplyr::transmute(t = .data$year, period = as.character(.data$year),
                         Interest = 100 * .data$interest / .data$gdp,
                         `Capital spending` = 100 * .data$capex / .data$gdp) |>
        tidyr::pivot_longer(-c("t", "period"), names_to = "item", values_to = "value")
      gf(line_chart(df, highlight = "Interest", title = "Interest Has Overtaken Capital Spending",
                    subtitle = "% of GDP (GDP before 2013 spliced to the 2013 base)", unit = "%"),
         height = 5)
    })

    output$p_int <- renderGirafe({
      df <- w() |>
        dplyr::transmute(t = .data$year, period = as.character(.data$year),
                         value = 100 * .data$interest / .data$total_revenue_grants) |>
        dplyr::mutate(hl = .data$value == max(.data$value))
      gf(col_chart(df, title = "Interest Payments as a Share of Revenue",
                   subtitle = "Interest / total revenue and grants; rust = highest in the period",
                   unit = "%", digits = 0),
         height = 5)
    })

    output$p_dec <- renderGirafe({
      req(input$years)
      df <- dat()$periodic |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$series_id == "capex", .data$figure_type == "provisional",
                      .data$period == "M12") |>
        dplyr::select("year", dec = "value") |>
        dplyr::inner_join(annual_wide(dat()) |> dplyr::select("year", "capex"), by = "year") |>
        dplyr::filter(.data$year >= input$years[1], .data$year <= input$years[2]) |>
        dplyr::transmute(t = .data$year, period = as.character(.data$year),
                         value = 100 * .data$dec / .data$capex)
      validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No full years in that period."))
      df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(hl = .data$value == max(.data$value))
      gf(col_chart(df, title = "The December Rush",
                   subtitle = "Share of each year's capital spending paid in December",
                   unit = "%", digits = 0, ref = 100 / 12, ref_label = "Even spread: 8% a month"),
         height = 5)
    })
  })
}
